metadata.methods_description: Participants performed a passive viewing task in a dimly lit room. Each trial consisted of a 1-second fixation cross with drift correction, followed by a 2-second presentation of a game board with occluder (game pieces appearing in the final 1 second), and a 1-second uncovered scene phase. The experiment comprised eight blocks of 80 trials each (640 total trials) with a 2×8 factorial design: 2 levels of initially visible pieces (4 or 32) crossed with 8 levels of uncovered pieces (0, 1, 2, 4, 28, 30, 31, or 32). Each condition was repeated 40 times.
